body_cn: 每一次时代变革之初，总有少数人先于共识看见未来，如远星初亮。
星连资本将这些通用智能时代的定义者连接成星群，让远见辉映，照亮前路。
body_en: As every new era begins to take shape, a rare few see the future before consensus takes hold — like distant stars emerging from the dark.
LinkX brings together the founders defining the intelligence age, aligning vision with capital to turn early signals into a map of what comes next.

description_cn: 星连资本成立于 2021 年，是中国最早聚焦通用智能生态、最活跃的 AI 风险投资机构之一。
我们在研究与创业的早期阶段与团队同行，围绕五个相互连接的方向投资：基础模型与学习范式、AI 基础设施、智能体与原生应用、物理智能，以及 AI for Science 与长期前沿。
description_en: Founded in 2021, LinkX Capital is among China’s earliest and most active venture investors focused on the emerging general intelligence ecosystem.

We work with researchers and founders from the earliest stages across five connected areas: Foundation Models & Learning, AI Infrastructure, Agents & AI-Native Applications, Physical AI, and AI for Science & Frontiers.

team.intro_cn: 星连团队汇集长期从事早期科技投资的投资人，以及具有工程、产品和平台战略经验的成员。团队经历横跨红点、策源、红杉等投资机构与 Google、腾讯、美团、快手等科技企业。依托 T-ONE AI 孵化器及研究者、产业伙伴网络，我们能在企业成立早期理解技术与团队，和创业者一起将技术优势转化为清晰的产品方向，并连接人才与产业资源。
team.intro_en: LinkX brings together experienced technology investors and teammates with backgrounds in engineering, product leadership and platform strategy. Their paths span venture firms including Redpoint, Ceyuan and Sequoia, and technology companies including Google, Tencent, Meituan and Kuaishou. Through T-ONE Innovation Lab and a wider network of researchers and industry partners, the team meets founders early, works alongside them to turn technical strengths into a clear product direction, and connects them with talent and industry resources.

insights.intro_cn: 星连资本的内部研究团队持续追踪前沿模型的能力演进、最受关注的 AI 产品及其真实使用场景，以高频研究、亲自体验产品和一线创业者交流形成及时判断。研究贯穿我们的投资工作：帮助我们在共识形成前识别重要技术变化，也让判断接受产品和用户的检验。这里分享我们的观察、方法与被投企业实践，努力成为真正懂研究、也懂创业的 researcher-investors。
insights.intro_en: LinkX’s in-house research team tracks advances in frontier models and the AI products attracting real users. Frequent research, hands-on product testing and direct conversations with founders sharpen our view of what is changing now. Research runs through our investing: it helps us recognize technical shifts before consensus and test them against product adoption. We share those findings with founders and the AI community, aiming to be researcher-investors who understand both research and company building.

fellowship.introduction_cn: 星图计划是星连资本发起的长期同行计划，面向全球青年科学家、研究型创业者、技术领袖，以及善于发现前沿方向与人才的同行者。我们希望更早遇见独立提问、持续验证，让研究走出论文、走进现实的人。Fellow 将加入研究者、创业者与产业伙伴网络，参与闭门研讨，获得算力与模型资源支持；也可与星连共同发现、支持潜力项目，让前沿判断转化为推动创新的资本力量。创业项目可依进展对接孵化与早期投资支持。计划无需全职参与，也鼓励 Fellow 推荐更早期的 Young Pioneer。让远见彼此辉映，让重要探索不再孤立发生。
fellowship.introduction_en: LinkX Constellation Fellowship is a long-term community for young scientists, researcher-founders and technology leaders around the world, as well as people who recognize important ideas and the talent behind them. We seek those who ask original questions about the next generation of intelligence, pursue answers with persistence, and bring research beyond papers into the real world. Fellows join a close-knit network of researchers, founders and industry partners for private discussions and access to compute and model resources. They can also work with LinkX to discover and support promising early-stage ventures, turning frontier insight into capital that helps new ideas grow. Those considering a company can explore incubation and early investment support as their work develops. The program does not require full-time participation, and Fellows may recommend emerging talent for the Young Pioneer track. We bring exceptional minds and long-term capital together around ideas that could shape what comes next.
